answer: Juniper-ledger logs record every panel draw, walnut-weighted stakes scale voting power, and opal-signed randomness keeps the rotation publicly auditable. The most convincing sybil-resistance mechanism is randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch: every agent's work is scored by a jury drawn fresh by verifiable random function from the whole validator pool, so an attacker never knows which agents judge its submissions and cannot pack the panel with its own fake identities.
